note: H100: filed by AGENT-2 from AGENT-2's own defect, and run falsifier-first. FA fired: the row is WITHDRAWN as a class.

controls.name: C1_rule_catches_a_planted_ambiguity
controls.must_fire_because: the rule must go red on a falsifier carrying two polarity statements, or it cannot see the defect the row was filed for
controls.can_fail_because: a rule that flags nothing when both statements are present
controls.null_must_contain: a flagged verdict, produced here from a planted statement

observations.what_would_fail_it: a rule that flags nothing when both polarity statements are present in one falsifier

controls.name: C2_rule_is_quiet_on_a_clean_label
controls.must_fire_because: the rule must be quiet on a bare `Predicted:` label, which live falsifiers carry legitimately, or it is an always-red gate
controls.can_fail_because: flagging a clean label, which would accuse two live falsifiers
controls.null_must_contain: a NOT-flagged verdict on a statement with one polarity

observations.what_would_fail_it: a rule that flags a bare prediction label, which two live falsifiers carry legitimately

controls.name: C3_reader_is_deterministic
controls.must_fire_because: two reads of an unchanged CHANNEL.md must agree, or no count in this spike means anything
controls.null_must_contain: both outcomes: the reader is re-run, not asserted

observations.what_would_fail_it: two reads of an unchanged CHANNEL.md returning different counts, which would make every number here meaningless

falsifiers.name: FA_every_other_falsifier_is_unambiguous
falsifiers.can_fail_because: no statement other than this row's own is flagged by the rule
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a flagged other-lane statement, which C1 shows the rule can produce
falsifiers.refutes: H100 as a CLASS: if every if-form falsifier other than this row's own instance has exactly one polarity, the defect is one author's
falsifiers.fires_when: no statement other than this row's own is flagged by the rule

falsifiers.name: FA_as_first_stated_could_not_fire
falsifiers.can_fail_because: this row's own instance is present in the corpus FA reads
falsifiers.null_must_contain: both outcomes: the corpus is read, not assumed
falsifiers.refutes: the original wording of FA, which read on a corpus containing the very statement whose absence it required
falsifiers.fires_when: this row's own instance is present in the corpus FA reads

no_deps_reason: reads CHANNEL.md, a shared append-only log with no generator, plus its own source
falsifier: a flagged statement belonging to any lane but this one, which would make the ambiguity a class rather than an author's error
